title: Green peas, canned, reduced sodium, cooked, no added fat

content.title: About
content.content: Canned green peas are a fully cooked, ready‑to‑eat product made from fresh pea pods that have been blanched, lightly salted, and sealed in a can. This version contains reduced sodium and no added fat, making it a convenient and healthier option for quick meals.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Green peas belong to the legume family and are an excellent source of plant‑based protein.
Canning preserves most B‑vitamins and minerals despite the heat treatment.
Reduced‑sodium varieties use a milder brine and a brief rinse before sealing to lower salt content.
Peas are a staple in many world cuisines, appearing in soups, purees, salads, and side dishes.
Canned peas have a long shelf life—typically 3 to 5 years when stored in a cool, dry place.

items.title: Rich in plant protein
items.content: One cup of canned peas provides about 8 g of protein, supporting muscle maintenance.

items.title: High in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber aids digestion, helps regulate blood sugar, and promotes satiety.

items.title: Source of B‑vitamins
items.content: Peas contain folate, thiamine, and vitamin B6, which are important for metabolism and nervous system health.

items.title: Contains iron and magnesium
items.content: These minerals contribute to hemoglobin formation and normal muscle and nerve function.

items.title: Reduced sodium
items.content: Lower salt levels make this product suitable for people monitoring blood pressure.

items.title: Legume allergy
items.content: Some individuals may experience allergic reactions to peas.

items.title: Natural sugars
items.content: Peas are naturally sweet; large portions can add to overall sugar intake.

items.title: Preservatives
items.content: Certain brands may add preservatives; check the label if you are sensitive.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Add peas to soups, stews, salads, mash them into a puree, or serve as a side dish. They can be heated quickly in the microwave or on the stovetop; rinsing before use can further reduce residual salt.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the unopened can in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, transfer leftovers to an airtight container and refrigerate for 3–4 days. Discard if you notice off‑odors or discoloration.
